title: SoftBody3D position data resets to vector zero in runtime after _ready() call
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in: 4.5.1 stable

### System information

Godot v4.5.1.stable unknown - Arch Linux #1 SMP PREEMPT_DYNAMIC Wed, 12 Nov 2025 14:41:18 +0000 on Wayland - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated AMD Radeon RX 6700 XT (RADV NAVI22) - AMD Ryzen 7 5800X 8-Core Processor (16 threads) - 31.22 GiB memory

### Issue description

When printing the position of a SoftBody3D node via the script:
1. in the _ready() function, it prints it as expected. it equals the editor value
2. in the _process(delta) and _physics_process(delta) function, it always prints as vector zero

When trying to change position values in the remote editor, it quickly resets to vector zero.

The expected behavior is to be able to read position data of a SoftBody3D node across runtime.

### Steps to reproduce

1. In a new project, create a 3D scene with a SoftBody3D node.
2. Attach any mesh, I am using a BoxMesh with no modifications.
3. Change the position of the SoftBody3D node to any xyz value. 
4. Attach a script to the SoftBody3D node:
```gdscript
extends SoftBody3D

func _ready():
	print('position in ready: ', position)
	
func _process(delta):
	print('position in process: ', position)


``` 
4. Run the game, observe the change in position in output.
